import math

# Unemployment insurance taxes for all 50 states (in thousands of dollars)
# Excluding DC (not a state) and other territories
states_data = {
    'Alabama': 64332,
    'Alaska': 10983,
    'Arizona': 109606,
    'Arkansas': 122270,
    'California': 735828,
    'Colorado': 97255,
    'Connecticut': 64286,
    'Delaware': 27166,
    'Florida': 417974,

    'Illinois': 271859,
    'Indiana': 100945,
    'Iowa': 49175,
    'Kansas': 66239,
    'Kentucky': 61165,
    'Louisiana': 62871,
    'Maine': 18204,
    'Maryland': 101598,
    'Massachusetts': 161146,
    'Michigan': 178509,
    'Minnesota': 170442,
    'Mississippi': 31420,
    'Missouri': 119199,
    'Montana': 15993,
    'Nebraska': 35205,
    'Nevada': 45885,
    'New Hampshire': 20345,
    'New Jersey': 187735,
    'New Mexico': 19766,
    'New York': 350082,
    'North Carolina': 190438,
    'North Dakota': 12812,
    'Ohio': 235458,
    'Oklahoma': 60206,
    'Oregon': 71863,
    'Pennsylvania': 257446,
    'Rhode Island': 25975,
    'South Carolina': 65892,
    'South Dakota': 12334,
    'Tennessee': 169376,
    'Texas': 536530,
    'Utah': 60537,
    'Vermont': 8471,
    'Virginia': 162666,
    'Washington': 209293,
    'West Virginia': 13475,
    'Wisconsin': 117667,
    'Wyoming': 7638
}

# Extract values and sort in descending order
values = sorted(states_data.values(), reverse=True)
print('Sorted values (descending):')
for i, v in enumerate(values):
    print(f'{i+1}: {v}')

k = 7
# Get the top k values
top_k = values[:k]
print(f'\\nTop {k} values: {top_k}')

# Hill estimator calculation
# α̂ = k / (∑_{i=1}^{k} log(X_{(i)} / X_{(k+1)}))
# X_{(k+1)} is the (k+1)th largest value
x_k_plus_1 = values[k]
print(f'X_{(k+1)} (value at position {k+1}): {x_k_plus_1}')

# Calculate sum of logs
log_sum = 0
for i in range(k):
    log_ratio = math.log(top_k[i] / x_k_plus_1)
    print(f'log({top_k[i]} / {x_k_plus_1}) = {log_ratio}')
    log_sum += log_ratio

alpha = k / log_sum
print(f'\\nHill estimator (Pareto tail exponent): {alpha}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(alpha, 3)}')
"
